verdict.rationale: Bulk registry extracts or datasets are a fair axis for a state business registry, but the evidence shows no bulk download. Access is per-search through SOSPortal at a $1.00 fee per search, and copies or certificates are ordered one document at a time. The freely downloadable forms directory is blank filing forms, not public data, so it earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
